description: A blocky black-faced ewe, deep in the chest and chewing steadily, standing square over three lambs whose backs come barely level with her knee.
A long rangy ewe lies flat out in the straw, chin down, eyes half shut, while her twins together take up less of the pen than she does.
A broad cream-fleeced ewe with dark rings round her eyes, one shoulder rubbed shiny from leaning, her two lambs no taller than her flank is deep.
A heavy-bellied ewe, soot-grey about the muzzle, dozing with her chin on the straw while three lambs mill across her broad back and flanks.
A tan-cheeked rangy ewe grazes with her nose to the grass, two lambs pressed against her belly, their heads clearing the field gate's bottom rail by nothing at all.
A neat compact ewe, speckle-nosed and watchful, stands over two lambs whose combined width is less than the depth of her chest.
A blocky cream-fleeced ewe, one ear notched pale, leans on the hurdle rail with her full weight, her three lambs a loose shuffling cluster below her chin.
A broad low ewe with a black face and deep springy fleece holds still over two lambs, the nearest one's head just clearing the bottom hurdle rail.
A long-bodied tan-cheeked ewe, carrying a dry wisp of straw across her back, chews steadily while her twins move under her belly without stooping.
A heavy deep-chested ewe, speckle-nosed, lies on her side in the straw, three lambs arranged in a loose uneven cluster against her flank, all of them chest-high to her at most.
A broad white-faced ewe with soot-grey about the muzzle stands at the field wall, chewing, her two lambs barely reaching the lowest course of stones.
A compact cream ewe, fleece flat and travel-worn down one flank, dozes upright with her eyes half shut while two lambs work their way beneath her chin.
A blocky black-faced ewe, rubbed shiny at one shoulder from a week on the same rail, stands placid over three lambs whose backs clear her knee by nothing.
A rangy speckle-nosed ewe, faintly long-suffering about the whole business, has her nose down working along two lambs, the larger one still only reaching her second rib.
A broad low ewe with dark rings round her eyes, deeply fleeced, holds square over three lambs; together they take up less floor than she does.
A heavy-bellied cream-fleeced ewe, chin propped on the straw bale's rim, watches four lambs scatter below her, none of them clearing the bale's top edge.
A long rangy tan-cheeked ewe grazes with absolute calm, her fleece carrying a wisp of dry grass; two lambs cluster at her near shoulder, their backs at her knee.
A blocky soot-grey-muzzled ewe, up on her front knees mid-rise, two lambs pressed to her near flank, their full height no more than the gap below the second hurdle rail.
A neat white-faced ewe with one ear notched pale, fleece springy and even, stands with her chin over the rail while her twins nose the straw beneath her belly.
A deep-chested black-faced ewe, rubbed shiny at one shoulder, lies with her chin flat down; three lambs cross her back and sides, none taller than her flank is broad.
A broad cream ewe, speckle-nosed and faintly long-suffering, chews through the whole performance while two lambs jostle beneath her; the nearer one barely clears her knee.
A rangy ewe with dark rings round her eyes, fleece flat on one side, stands over a single strong lamb with a second ewe's twin adopted close; all three fit under her chest.
A blocky tan-cheeked ewe leans into the field wall, chewing steadily, her three lambs a loose uneven mob at her feet, each one a fraction short of her knee.
A low broad soot-grey-muzzled ewe, dozing with her eyes half shut, lets two lambs scramble across her deep springy fleece; neither reaches the height of her back standing.
A heavy cream-fleeced ewe, slow and measured, stands square over three lambs; the nearest one presses its cheek to her front leg, its head level with her knee joint.
